concepts.name: Zipper
concepts.descriptor: Two rows of interlocking teeth are meshed sequentially by a slider so a one-dimensional pass binds a whole seam.

concepts.name: Junk drawer
concepts.descriptor: A single uncategorized container absorbs every item too useful to discard but too odd to file, growing by default.

concepts.name: Key ring
concepts.descriptor: Unrelated keys accrete onto one loop so a single physical bundle indexes access to many separate locks.

concepts.name: Velcro
concepts.descriptor: Stiff hooks catch soft loops on contact, giving a fastener that is strong in shear yet peels apart with a low normal force.

concepts.name: Tupperware lid mismatch
concepts.descriptor: Containers and lids drift into separate piles so the search cost to pair them grows faster than the collection.

concepts.name: Tangled charger cables
concepts.descriptor: Flexible cords stored loosely self-knot through random agitation, so disorder accumulates without anyone tying anything.

concepts.name: Spare-button bag
concepts.descriptor: Garments ship with a tiny reserve part stored against a future failure that usually never gets repaired.

concepts.name: Refrigerator leftovers
concepts.descriptor: Saved portions queue silently until they cross an invisible spoilage deadline and convert from asset to waste.

concepts.name: Sock single survivor
concepts.descriptor: Paired items lose partners one at a time in the laundry, leaving an accumulating pool of unmatchable singletons.

concepts.name: Doormat
concepts.descriptor: A boundary object strips contamination off entrants so the threshold absorbs dirt the interior would otherwise gather.

concepts.name: Umbrella inversion in wind
concepts.descriptor: A canopy built to shed downward force flips inside out when the load reverses past its hinge's design direction.

concepts.name: Nesting measuring cups
concepts.descriptor: Graduated sizes stack inside one another so a whole range of capacities occupies the footprint of the largest.

concepts.name: Rubber-band ball
concepts.descriptor: Small elastic loops are wrapped over each other into a single dense store whose tension holds it together.

concepts.name: Childproof cap
concepts.descriptor: Opening requires two simultaneous uncorrelated actions, raising the access barrier just past a child's coordination.

concepts.name: Squeaky floorboard
concepts.descriptor: A loose joint emits sound only under load at one spot, broadcasting presence involuntarily when stepped on.

concepts.name: Fridge magnet collection
concepts.descriptor: Flat tokens pin loose papers to a vertical surface, turning the door into an unsorted shared bulletin board.

concepts.name: Lost-and-found box
concepts.descriptor: Orphaned items pool at a known location waiting to be reclaimed, with abandonment rising the longer they sit.

concepts.name: Squeezed toothpaste tube
concepts.descriptor: Contents migrate away from the opening so extracting the last fraction takes disproportionate rolling effort.

concepts.name: Doorstop wedge
concepts.descriptor: A small tapered block converts a door's swing into static friction, holding open a heavy thing with a trivial part.

concepts.name: Overstuffed wallet
concepts.descriptor: Rarely-used cards and receipts accumulate in a carried container until bulk outweighs the value of holding them.

concepts.name: Bookmark left in place
concepts.descriptor: A thin marker freezes a position in a long sequence so reading can pause and resume without re-scanning.

concepts.name: Squeaky shopping-cart wheel
concepts.descriptor: One misaligned caster pulls the whole load off course, so a tiny defect steers a large object persistently.

concepts.name: Morning commute
concepts.descriptor: Many independent travelers converging on shared infrastructure at the same hour produce predictable congestion peaks.

concepts.name: Queueing in line
concepts.descriptor: A first-come ordering converts simultaneous demand into a fair serial sequence enforced only by social pressure.

concepts.name: Snooze button
concepts.descriptor: A repeatable short deferral lets a person postpone an event in small increments while the deadline keeps advancing.

concepts.name: Gift-wrapping
concepts.descriptor: A concealing layer delays disclosure of contents so the reveal becomes a discrete ceremonial moment.

concepts.name: Spring cleaning
concepts.descriptor: Accumulated clutter is purged in one periodic burst rather than continuously, syncing disorder reset to a season.

concepts.name: Saving the good china
concepts.descriptor: A valued resource is reserved for an undefined special occasion that may never arrive, so it stays perpetually unused.

concepts.name: Bedtime story
concepts.descriptor: A repeated wind-down sequence cues a child's transition from waking activity to sleep through predictable ritual.

concepts.name: Coffee order ritual
concepts.descriptor: A fixed personal recipe repeated daily compresses a complex preference into a single habitual request.

concepts.name: New Year's resolution
concepts.descriptor: Behavior change is anchored to a calendar boundary, concentrating intention at one date that mostly decays afterward.

concepts.name: Toasting before drinking
concepts.descriptor: A synchronized gesture aligns a group's attention and intent into one shared instant before consumption.

concepts.name: Locking up at night
concepts.descriptor: A fixed end-of-day checklist secures a space by sequentially verifying each opening before standing down.

concepts.name: Watering the plants
concepts.descriptor: A periodic small input sustains a slow living process whose failure shows only after a lag of neglect.

concepts.name: Doom-scrolling
concepts.descriptor: An endless feed delivers intermittent rewards so a brief check stretches into compulsive open-ended consumption.

concepts.name: Folding laundry
concepts.descriptor: Disordered flexible items are compressed into stackable standardized shapes for dense reversible storage.

concepts.name: Setting the table
concepts.descriptor: Utensils are pre-positioned in a conventional layout so a shared meal runs without mid-event fetching.

concepts.name: Nostalgia
concepts.descriptor: Past experience is recalled with selectively softened affect, weighting fond detail over the discomfort that accompanied it.

concepts.name: Spite
concepts.descriptor: A person accepts a cost to themselves purely to impose a larger cost on someone who wronged them.

concepts.name: Procrastination
concepts.descriptor: An unpleasant task is deferred toward its deadline as present relief is overweighted against rising future pressure.

concepts.name: Awkward silence
concepts.descriptor: A conversational gap past the expected response window generates mutual discomfort that pressures someone to fill it.

concepts.name: Deja vu
concepts.descriptor: A novel scene triggers a false familiarity signal, so recognition fires without any matching stored memory.

concepts.name: Buyer's remorse
concepts.descriptor: After commitment, attention shifts to forgone alternatives so a chosen option's appeal drops once it is irreversible.

concepts.name: Schadenfreude
concepts.descriptor: Another's misfortune yields private pleasure when it relieves an envious comparison against them.

concepts.name: Stage fright
concepts.descriptor: Anticipated evaluation by an audience floods the body with arousal that degrades the very performance being judged.

concepts.name: Sunk-cost attachment
concepts.descriptor: Past irrecoverable investment irrationally inflates willingness to keep pouring resources into a failing course.

concepts.name: Itch to check phone
concepts.descriptor: An unpredictable reward schedule conditions a compulsive checking urge that recurs faster than any real update arrives.

concepts.name: Tip-of-the-tongue
concepts.descriptor: A target word is felt as present and almost-retrievable yet blocked, with partial features available but not the whole.

concepts.name: Hangry irritability
concepts.descriptor: A bodily energy deficit lowers the threshold for irritation so unrelated friction provokes outsized reaction.

concepts.name: Impostor feeling
concepts.descriptor: Competence is discounted as luck so external success fails to update an internal sense of being a fraud.

concepts.name: Earworm song loop
concepts.descriptor: A catchy fragment replays involuntarily, with suppression attempts paradoxically refreshing the loop.

concepts.name: Comfort-zone inertia
concepts.descriptor: Familiar low-stakes options are preferred over higher-value risky ones because uncertainty itself is felt as cost.

concepts.name: Decision fatigue
concepts.descriptor: Successive choices deplete deliberation so later decisions default to whatever is easiest or already presented.

concepts.name: Anticipation savoring
concepts.descriptor: Looking forward to an event yields pleasure ahead of it, sometimes exceeding the enjoyment of the event itself.

concepts.name: Grudge
concepts.descriptor: A past slight is retained as durable hostile memory that biases all later dealings with the offender.

concepts.name: Cold feet
concepts.descriptor: As a commitment nears, accumulating doubt surges precisely at the threshold of irreversibility.

concepts.name: Gossip
concepts.descriptor: Reputational information about absent third parties spreads peer-to-peer, mutating as it passes through each teller.

concepts.name: Seating chart
concepts.descriptor: A host pre-assigns positions to manage who is adjacent, engineering interaction by controlling the proximity graph.

concepts.name: Inside joke
concepts.descriptor: A shared private reference cheaply signals membership and excludes outsiders who lack the originating context.

concepts.name: Reputation
concepts.descriptor: Distributed memory of a person's past conduct serves as collateral that gates future cooperation with them.

concepts.name: Hand-me-downs
concepts.descriptor: Durable goods cascade down a kin hierarchy by age, extending one purchase across several successive users.

concepts.name: Awkward family reunion
concepts.descriptor: Dormant relationships are reactivated en masse so stale grievances and roles resurface under forced proximity.

concepts.name: Wingman
concepts.descriptor: A third party brokers a social connection by vouching and smoothing, lowering the risk of a direct first approach.

concepts.name: Saving a seat
concepts.descriptor: A placeholder object or claim reserves a shared resource for an absent ally against first-come norms.

concepts.name: Group-chat lurker
concepts.descriptor: A silent member consumes shared updates without contributing, free-riding on others' posting effort.

concepts.name: Plus-one invitation
concepts.descriptor: An invitee is granted one transferable extra slot, propagating attendance one hop beyond the original guest list.

concepts.name: Icebreaker
concepts.descriptor: A low-stakes prompt lowers the activation barrier to interaction among strangers who would otherwise stay silent.

concepts.name: Peer pressure
concepts.descriptor: An individual conforms to a visible group behavior to avoid the social cost of deviating from the majority.

concepts.name: Name-dropping
concepts.descriptor: Mentioning a prestigious association borrows that party's status to inflate the speaker's own standing.

concepts.name: Family resemblance trait
concepts.descriptor: A heritable feature recurs across relatives, letting observers infer kinship from shared partial markers.

concepts.name: Secret-keeping pact
concepts.descriptor: Shared concealment of information binds its holders, since any leak would damage all parties at once.

concepts.name: Pecking-order seating
concepts.descriptor: Status determines spatial position at a table, encoding an invisible hierarchy into who sits where.

concepts.name: Inherited heirloom
concepts.descriptor: A single object carries accumulated family meaning forward across generations beyond its material worth.

concepts.name: Haggling
concepts.descriptor: Buyer and seller converge on a price through alternating concessions, each probing the other's hidden reservation value.

concepts.name: Tipping
concepts.descriptor: A discretionary post-service payment relies on social norm to reward quality the contract did not price.

concepts.name: Stockpiling a sale
concepts.descriptor: A temporary low price triggers buying far beyond current need, betting storage cost is less than the discount.

concepts.name: Loyalty punch card
concepts.descriptor: Accumulated purchases unlock a delayed reward, locking a customer in by making switching forfeit progress.

concepts.name: Splitting the bill
concepts.descriptor: A shared cost divided evenly weakens each diner's incentive to restrain their own ordering.

concepts.name: Coupon clipping
concepts.descriptor: Effort spent to capture a discount is a self-selection test that sorts price-sensitive buyers from the rest.

concepts.name: Layaway plan
concepts.descriptor: A good is reserved and paid for in installments before delivery, trading immediate possession for spread cost.

concepts.name: Impulse-buy at checkout
concepts.descriptor: Small temptations placed at the point of payment exploit a depleted, captive shopper for unplanned purchases.

concepts.name: Bulk-buy warehouse run
concepts.descriptor: Lower unit price at high volume shifts inventory and spoilage risk from seller to household.

concepts.name: IOU between friends
concepts.descriptor: An informal unrecorded debt relies on memory and goodwill, accruing imbalance until socially settled.

concepts.name: Round-number anchoring
concepts.descriptor: An initial stated figure pulls the final negotiated amount toward itself regardless of its arbitrariness.

concepts.name: Free-sample reciprocity
concepts.descriptor: An unsolicited small gift induces a felt obligation that raises the recipient's likelihood of buying.

concepts.name: Garage sale pricing
concepts.descriptor: Owners liquidate idle goods at steep discounts, with price falling through the day as the deadline to clear nears.

concepts.name: Subscription creep
concepts.descriptor: Small recurring charges auto-renew below the threshold of notice, so total spend grows by inertia.

concepts.name: Bartering swap
concepts.descriptor: Goods trade directly without money, requiring a double coincidence of wants between the two parties.

concepts.name: Knitting
concepts.descriptor: A single continuous thread is built into a two-dimensional fabric by chained loops, so one break can unravel the whole.

concepts.name: Tag chase game
concepts.descriptor: A single contagious role passes by touch through a population, with the carrier seeking to offload it.

concepts.name: Jigsaw puzzle
concepts.descriptor: Fragments are reassembled by matching local edge and image cues, with constraints tightening as the picture fills.

concepts.name: Fishing
concepts.descriptor: A baited lure waits passively in a medium for a rare event, rewarding patience over continuous effort.

concepts.name: Friendship bracelet braiding
concepts.descriptor: Many strands are interleaved by a repeating knot pattern so a one-dimensional bundle yields a fixed two-dimensional motif.

concepts.name: Hide-and-seek
concepts.descriptor: One searcher explores a space against hiders who exploit concealment, balancing detection effort against hiding time.

concepts.name: Whittling
concepts.descriptor: Form emerges by subtractive removal of small slivers, an irreversible process where each cut forecloses options.

concepts.name: Domino chain reaction
concepts.descriptor: Stored potential energy in a line releases as one toppling element triggers the next in a propagating cascade.

concepts.name: Crossword puzzle
concepts.descriptor: Intersecting answers mutually constrain each other so a confident entry reduces ambiguity in crossing slots.

concepts.name: Skipping stones
concepts.descriptor: A flat object bounces across water when speed and angle keep it above the threshold for surface rebound.

concepts.name: Tug of war
concepts.descriptor: Two teams apply opposing force on one rope so the equilibrium holds until one side's collective effort tips it.

concepts.name: Pottery on a wheel
concepts.descriptor: Rotational symmetry lets steady hand pressure shape a vessel as spin distributes the deformation evenly.

concepts.name: Marbles knockout
concepts.descriptor: Players displace opponents' pieces from a zone by impact, accumulating winnings through skilled collisions.

concepts.name: Hopscotch
concepts.descriptor: A body traverses a numbered grid under movement constraints that grow harder as the path lengthens.

concepts.name: Frisbee throw
concepts.descriptor: Spin-stabilized lift keeps a disc aloft on a curved path that both players must predict to complete the exchange.

concepts.name: Cat's cradle string figures
concepts.descriptor: A looped string is transformed through hand-offs where each move's validity depends on the prior configuration.

concepts.name: Solitaire card game
concepts.descriptor: A single player orders a shuffled deck under stacking rules where early moves can lock later positions unsolvable.

concepts.name: Fermentation
concepts.descriptor: Microbes transform a substrate over time, with a starter population shifting flavor and preserving against spoilage.

concepts.name: Marination
concepts.descriptor: Flavor and tenderizing agents diffuse slowly inward from the surface, so soak time sets penetration depth.

concepts.name: Mise en place
concepts.descriptor: All ingredients are measured and arranged before cooking so execution proceeds without mid-process interruption.

concepts.name: Potluck
concepts.descriptor: Each guest brings one uncoordinated dish so the collective spread emerges without a central menu plan.

concepts.name: Sourdough starter
concepts.descriptor: A self-sustaining microbial culture is kept alive by periodic feeding, lineage carried forward indefinitely from a portion.

concepts.name: Stale bread
concepts.descriptor: Starch retrogrades over time, hardening texture in a way partly reversible by reheating but not by waiting.

concepts.name: Resting the meat
concepts.descriptor: A cooked roast is left to sit so internal juices redistribute, trading immediate slicing for retained moisture.

concepts.name: Emulsion of dressing
concepts.descriptor: Two unmixable liquids are forced into a stable suspension by an emulsifier and vigorous agitation.

concepts.name: Proofing dough
concepts.descriptor: Yeast gas inflates the dough during a timed rest, where under- or over-proofing both collapse the final rise.

concepts.name: Reducing a sauce
concepts.descriptor: Simmering evaporates water so volume falls while flavor and viscosity concentrate in what remains.

concepts.name: Caramelizing onions
concepts.descriptor: Low slow heat browns sugars over a long window where rushing the temperature burns rather than sweetens.

concepts.name: Brining
concepts.descriptor: Salt solution drives water into cells by osmosis so the food holds moisture against later cooking loss.

concepts.name: Pickling
concepts.descriptor: An acidic bath halts spoilage organisms, converting perishable produce into a shelf-stable preserved form.

concepts.name: Tempering chocolate
concepts.descriptor: Controlled heat-cool cycling selects a stable crystal form that gives snap and gloss instead of dull bloom.

concepts.name: Blanching
concepts.descriptor: A brief boil then ice plunge halts enzyme action at a precise point, fixing color and texture.

concepts.name: Composting
concepts.descriptor: Mixed organic scraps are decomposed by microbes into stable soil amendment, with balance of inputs setting the rate.

concepts.name: Tides
concepts.descriptor: Gravitational pull cycles sea level on a regular period, so the same shore alternates exposed and submerged.

concepts.name: Bird migration
concepts.descriptor: Populations move seasonally along learned routes between resource peaks, timing departure to environmental cues.

concepts.name: Frost
concepts.descriptor: Surfaces radiating heat on a still clear night dip below freezing so water deposits directly as ice crystals.

concepts.name: Dawn chorus
concepts.descriptor: Birds compress their loudest singing into the low-noise window at first light when sound carries farthest.

concepts.name: Symbiosis
concepts.descriptor: Two species sustain a tight exchange where each supplies what the other cannot make for itself.

concepts.name: Leaves changing color
concepts.descriptor: A plant withdraws and recycles its green pigment before shedding, unmasking the colors that were there all along.

concepts.name: Dew formation
concepts.descriptor: Air cooling past its saturation point at night condenses moisture onto surfaces below the dew-point temperature.

concepts.name: Tree rings
concepts.descriptor: Seasonal growth lays down annual bands whose widths passively record each year's conditions in order.

concepts.name: Murmuration of starlings
concepts.descriptor: Each bird tracks only a few neighbors so simple local rules produce coordinated flock-wide shape shifts.

concepts.name: Ripening fruit cluster
concepts.descriptor: One ripe fruit emits a gas that accelerates ripening in neighbors, propagating maturity through proximity.

concepts.name: Puddle evaporation
concepts.descriptor: Standing water shrinks from its edges as molecules leave the surface, vanishing faster as area-to-volume rises.

concepts.name: Spider web repair
concepts.descriptor: A damaged trap is patched locally rather than rebuilt, restoring function at the lowest silk expenditure.

concepts.name: Moss on the north side
concepts.descriptor: A organism colonizes the consistently shaded, moister face, so its growth passively encodes orientation.

concepts.name: Salmon run upstream
concepts.descriptor: Fish expend a lifetime's reserves to swim against current back to a natal site for a single reproductive event.

concepts.name: Pollination handoff
concepts.descriptor: A mobile vector unknowingly carries reproductive material between stationary partners in exchange for a reward.

concepts.name: Snowdrift accumulation
concepts.descriptor: Wind deposits particles where its speed drops behind an obstacle, so shelter shapes where the pile grows.

concepts.name: Lightning discharge
concepts.descriptor: Charge separation builds until it exceeds the air's breakdown threshold, releasing in one sudden conducting path.

concepts.name: Beaver dam impoundment
concepts.descriptor: An animal reshapes its environment by blocking flow, creating the pond habitat its lifestyle requires.

concepts.name: Stranded ecosystem in a drying pool
concepts.descriptor: A shrinking isolated basin traps a small community that must endure rising crowding and scarcity until outside water returns.

concepts.name: Algal bloom
concepts.descriptor: A nutrient surge triggers explosive population growth that overshoots, then crashes as it exhausts its own resource.

concepts.name: Callus formation
concepts.descriptor: Repeated friction thickens skin precisely where load recurs, building local protection in proportion to use.

concepts.name: Scar tissue
concepts.descriptor: A wound heals with hastily-laid disordered fibers that restore closure but never the original full function.

concepts.name: Muscle memory
concepts.descriptor: A practiced motor sequence becomes automatic so it runs accurately without conscious step-by-step control.

concepts.name: Hunger pang
concepts.descriptor: An energy deficit signal escalates on a rising schedule until eating resets it, regardless of conscious plans.

concepts.name: Jet lag
concepts.descriptor: An internal clock lags an abruptly shifted external schedule, desynchronized until it slowly re-entrains.

concepts.name: Adrenaline rush
concepts.descriptor: A perceived threat triggers a fast whole-body resource mobilization that boosts capacity at a later recovery cost.

concepts.name: Sleep debt
concepts.descriptor: Lost rest accumulates as a deficit that degrades function and must eventually be repaid, only partly by extra sleep.

concepts.name: Yawn contagion
concepts.descriptor: Seeing one person yawn triggers the same reflex in observers, spreading an involuntary act socially.

concepts.name: Goosebumps
concepts.descriptor: An old reflex erects body hair in response to cold or emotion, an involuntary display detached from its original use.

concepts.name: Second wind
concepts.descriptor: Exertion past an early fatigue point yields a renewed surge of capacity as the body shifts energy systems.

concepts.name: Bruise color cycle
concepts.descriptor: Pooled blood under skin is broken down in stages, so the visible color reliably encodes the injury's age.

concepts.name: Numb foot pins-and-needles
concepts.descriptor: Sustained pressure silences a nerve, and its noisy misfiring recovery signals the return of blood flow.

concepts.name: Acquired taste
concepts.descriptor: Repeated exposure to an initially aversive flavor gradually flips it into a preferred one through familiarization.

concepts.name: Brain freeze
concepts.descriptor: Rapid cold on the palate triggers referred pain elsewhere, a misrouted signal from a sudden temperature shock.

concepts.name: Fading suntan
concepts.descriptor: A protective pigment response builds under exposure then decays once the stimulus stops, lagging the cause both ways.

concepts.name: Hiccup loop
concepts.descriptor: A reflex arc gets stuck firing rhythmically, self-perpetuating until some interruption breaks the cycle.

concepts.name: Pun
concepts.descriptor: One sound maps to two meanings so a single phrase activates both senses, with the clash producing the effect.

concepts.name: Musical harmony
concepts.descriptor: Simultaneous notes in simple frequency ratios fuse into consonance, while complex ratios sound tense.

concepts.name: Jazz improvisation
concepts.descriptor: Players generate novel lines in real time within a shared harmonic frame that constrains without scripting.

concepts.name: Rumor spread
concepts.descriptor: An unverified claim propagates through a network, amplifying and distorting at each retelling without a source check.

concepts.name: Fashion cycle
concepts.descriptor: A style spreads from early adopters to the mass, then is abandoned by the leaders precisely because it became common.

concepts.name: Call and response
concepts.descriptor: A leader's phrase is answered by a group in alternation, building cohesion through structured turn-taking.

concepts.name: Rhyme scheme
concepts.descriptor: Recurring end-sounds at fixed intervals create expectation whose fulfillment binds lines into a remembered structure.

concepts.name: Meme remix
concepts.descriptor: A shared template is recombined with new content so the format persists while instances mutate and compete.

concepts.name: Slang drift
concepts.descriptor: Words shift meaning as groups adopt and repurpose them, with novelty fading once usage becomes mainstream.

concepts.name: Syncopation
concepts.descriptor: Accents are placed off the expected beat so the rhythm pulls against the underlying pulse to create drive.

concepts.name: Telephone-game distortion
concepts.descriptor: A message passed serially through people accumulates small errors until the output diverges wildly from the input.

concepts.name: Crescendo build
concepts.descriptor: A gradual rise in intensity over time raises tension toward a release point that the climb itself sets up.

concepts.name: Catchphrase
concepts.descriptor: A compact repeated expression becomes a reusable handle that evokes a whole character or context in a few words.

concepts.name: Whisper acoustics in a gallery
concepts.descriptor: A curved surface focuses faint sound to a distant point so a whisper carries where a shout would not.

concepts.name: Doorbell answering delay
concepts.descriptor: A signal arrives but response lags by the time to traverse the space, so the caller waits through an uncertain gap.

concepts.name: Spinning plates act
concepts.descriptor: Many objects each decay toward failure so the performer must revisit each before it falls, bounding how many fit.

concepts.name: Carpooling
concepts.descriptor: Riders share one vehicle and split cost, pooling individual trips into a joint route that adds coordination overhead.

concepts.name: Standing ovation cascade
concepts.descriptor: A few people rising lowers the threshold for neighbors, so a local spark can tip a whole audience to its feet.

concepts.name: Wear path across a lawn
concepts.descriptor: Repeated foot traffic kills grass along the shortcut people actually take, so usage carves its own visible trail.

concepts.name: Heirloom seed saving
concepts.descriptor: Growers keep seed from the best plants each season so a variety is carried forward by selective propagation.

concepts.name: Breaking in new shoes
concepts.descriptor: A stiff object and a body mutually deform over use until the fit improves, trading early discomfort for later comfort.

concepts.name: Doodling in margins
concepts.descriptor: Idle hands fill empty space with low-stakes marks while attention is elsewhere, a byproduct of occupied focus.

concepts.name: Pantry rotation
concepts.descriptor: Older stock is moved to the front so consumption follows arrival order and nothing expires forgotten at the back.

concepts.name: Whittling a queue at a deli
concepts.descriptor: A numbered-ticket system replaces a physical line so people hold their place without standing in order.

concepts.name: Borrowing and not returning
concepts.descriptor: Lent items drift permanently to the borrower as the social cost of asking back exceeds each item's value.

concepts.name: Window shopping
concepts.descriptor: A browser samples options with no intent to buy, gathering information while deferring or avoiding commitment.

concepts.name: Building a campfire
concepts.descriptor: Fuel is staged from small to large so a fragile initial flame can grow before it must sustain heavier material.

concepts.name: Letting bread go stale for crumbs
concepts.descriptor: A degraded state is deliberately induced because the aged form serves a use the fresh one cannot.

concepts.name: First snow hush
concepts.descriptor: Fresh snow's porous structure absorbs sound so a fall briefly damps the ambient noise of a whole area.

concepts.name: Stretching before exercise
concepts.descriptor: A preparatory routine primes tissue for load, raising the threshold at which strain turns into injury.

concepts.name: Encore demand
concepts.descriptor: An audience withholds its exit to coerce an unscheduled extra, converting collective insistence into a return.

concepts.name: Re-gifting
concepts.descriptor: An unwanted present is passed onward as a new gift, recirculating an item while masking its prior history.

concepts.name: Dollar-store impulse aisle
concepts.descriptor: Uniform low prices remove price comparison so choices hinge on want alone, inflating basket count.

concepts.name: Dog marking territory
concepts.descriptor: An animal deposits durable scent signals along a boundary so its claim persists in its physical absence.

concepts.name: Catching a cold around the office
concepts.descriptor: A pathogen spreads through shared air and surfaces, with one introduction seeding waves through a connected group.
